name: Babelbeez Voice AI
author: Oliver Cheung

sections.description:
The “Call Now” button that answers itself.

Adding a “Click to Call” button to your site is great for customers, but terrible for you. It means your phone rings during dinner, spam calls flood your line, and you miss leads when you sleep.

Babelbeez is the Smart Call Button.

It adds a beautiful Floating Contact Button (Sticky Button) to your site. When a customer clicks it, they don’t open a phone dialer. Instead, they speak directly to an AI voice agent right in their browser. The AI answers their questions, qualifies the lead, and sends you a summary.

Your customer gets to talk. You get to sleep.

Why replace your old Call Button?

  • No Phone Bill: Uses browser-based audio instead of a phone line. No carrier fees, no SIP trunks, no international calling costs.
  • Less Spam: Since it’s not a phone number, robo-dialers can’t call it directly.
  • Instant Answers: The AI can be trained on your website content so it knows your hours, pricing, and services.
  • Zero Per-Seat Fees: Unlike “Live Chat” tools that charge per agent, billing is based on usage/minutes, not per‑user seats.

Key Features

  • Native Speech‑to‑Speech: Real-time, conversational AI voice for natural, low-latency conversations.
  • Floating Widget: A clean, mobile‑responsive sticky button that stays visible as users scroll.
  • Works on Mobile: Designed for visitors who hate typing on tiny screens.
  • Human Handoff: If the AI can’t help, it captures the user’s details and emails you so you never lose a lead.
  • Multilingual: Automatically detects the visitor’s language and responds in kind.
  • Automatic Chat Summaries: Quickly review summaries of every interaction.
  • Secure Transport: Conversations are encrypted in transit over HTTPS/WSS between your site, Babelbeez, and OpenAI.

How It Works

  1. Create: Sign up at Babelbeez.com.
  2. Train: Paste your website link—and optionally upload PDFs—to build your agent’s knowledge.
  3. Embed: Use this plugin to add the Smart Call Button to your WordPress site.

Note: All configuration (knowledge, behavior, prompts, routing, etc.) happens on the Babelbeez platform. This plugin is the connector that embeds an existing, configured agent.

All voice agent creation and configuration is done on the Babelbeez platform. This plugin is for embedding an existing, configured voice agent.

Third-Party Services and Data

This plugin requires a connection to the Babelbeez service to function. By using this plugin, you agree to the terms of the following third-party services:

  • Babelbeez (https://www.babelbeez.com): The primary service that powers the voice agent. It handles the creation, configuration, and management of your voice agents. Your API key is sent to this service for authentication. See:

    • Terms of Service
    • Privacy Policy

  • OpenAI (https://openai.com): Babelbeez is built on OpenAI’s AI models. During a conversation, the real-time audio stream from the user is sent to OpenAI for processing to generate a response.

This plugin does not track any user data on your WordPress server beyond storing configuration options (such as your API key and selected agent ID). All conversation processing is handled by the services listed above and is subject to their respective privacy policies.

Shortcodes

Use the shortcode to embed on specific pages when Load Site-wide is disabled.

Basic:

[babelbeez_voice_ai]

With an explicit agent (overrides the saved selection):

[babelbeez_voice_ai id=”PUBLIC_CHATBOT_ID”]

Privacy

  • This plugin stores your Babelbeez API key and selected agent ID in your site’s options table.
  • Conversations and related processing are handled by Babelbeez and OpenAI. Please review:
    • Privacy Policy
    • Terms of Service
sections.installation:
1. Upload the babelbeez-voice-ai folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress “Plugins” screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the new “Babelbeez” menu in your WordPress admin.
  4. In your Babelbeez Dashboard, open your voice agent and find your API Key in the “Go Live” / “Embed” section.
  5. Paste your API key into the Babelbeez settings page (do not click Save yet).
  6. Click Fetch Voice Agents to load the latest list from your account.
  7. Select your desired voice agent from the dropdown.
  8. Click Save & Make Live. Your voice agent is now live on your site.
  9. Optional: Uncheck Load Site-wide if you only want the agent to load on certain pages via the shortcode.
sections.faq:
Is this a real phone number?

No. It connects via the internet (similar to a browser-based call), so there are no traditional phone bills or geographic restrictions.

Why isn’t this free like some other AI plugins?

Real-time AI voice is resource-intensive to run. We charge a transparent usage-based rate so we can operate sustainably, keep your data private to our service and providers, and avoid relying on ads or reselling user data.

Where do I find my API key?

You can find your API key in the “Go Live” or “Embed” section of your voice agent’s configuration page on the Babelbeez dashboard.

Can I create or configure my voice agent from within WordPress?

No. All voice agent creation and configuration is done on the Babelbeez platform. This plugin is for embedding an existing voice agent.

Does this work on mobile?

Yes, the voice agent and floating button are designed to be responsive and work effectively across desktops, tablets, and mobile phones.

Is it secure?

Traffic between your site and Babelbeez/OpenAI is protected in transit via HTTPS/WSS. See our Privacy Policy for details on how data is handled.

How do I only show the agent on certain pages?

Uncheck Load Site-wide on the Babelbeez settings page, then add the [babelbeez_voice_ai] shortcode to the pages where you want it to appear.

Is this a WordPress chatbot plugin?

Yes. Babelbeez is a voice-first chatbot for WordPress. It provides AI customer service via real-time voice and can complement or replace text-based live chat.

Can it act as my AI customer service plugin?

Yes—answer FAQs, pre-qualify leads, triage support, capture details, and escalate to human agents when needed.

How is this different from live chat?

It responds instantly via voice, providing a faster, more personal experience than text chat. When a case needs a human, it escalates smoothly.
sections.changelog:
1.1.3

  • Confirmed compatibility with WordPress 6.9.
  • Improved uninstall cleanup globals naming to satisfy Plugin Check.

1.1.2

  • Admin banner updated to 1544×500 and UI reference updated.
  • Readme: improved SEO (5 tags), added FAQs and expanded features.
  • Added screenshots 1–3 and captions.

1.1.1

  • Removed discouraged load_plugin_textdomain; rely on WordPress.org auto-loading (WP 4.6+).
  • Replaced direct database query in uninstall with get_sites() for multisite cleanup.

1.1.0

  • New: One-save setup. Enter API key, click “Fetch Voice Agents” (no save required), choose agent, then “Save & Make Live”.
  • New: Polished admin UI with banner and clearer step-by-step flow.
  • New: Optional shortcode [babelbeez_voice_ai] for per-page embedding; “Load Site-wide” toggle added.
  • New: Loader script marked defer and canonicalized to https://www.babelbeez.com/... for faster loading.
  • New: Uninstall cleanup removes options. Text domain loading for translations.

1.0.1

  • Tweak: Added third-party service disclosure to readme to comply with WordPress.org guidelines.
  • Tweak: Renamed main plugin file to match slug babelbeez-voice-ai.php.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
